question: Can I request a custom print without a model?
answer: Yes. Start with a description of your idea in the enquiry form. Dimensions, intended use and a preferred colour help define the project. Design feasibility and any modelling work will need to be confirmed.

question: Which model files can I select?
answer: You can select STL, OBJ and 3MF files. At this stage, files stay on your device. The saved enquiry brief includes the filename, so keep the model separately for when contact channels open.

question: Can I choose a colour, material or size?
answer: You can include your preferences in your enquiry. Final material, colour availability, dimensions and pricing will be confirmed before printing.

question: How long will printing and delivery take?
answer: Timing depends on the model, quantity and finishing requirements. Production lead times, delivery options and costs will be confirmed with your order before payment.

question: Can I place an online order today?
answer: You can try PayFast sandbox checkout using test funds, explore products, and save a custom enquiry brief. Sandbox transactions do not create real orders. Completing or cancelling checkout returns to our preview website; payment notifications are not connected yet.
